_commentaire: Manifeste du module anglais lakour-fenoir-en (engendré par outils/fabriquer-fenoir.mjs --langue en) : ce qui change par rapport à modules/lakour-fenoir/module.json. Le reste (version, auteurs, compatibilité, système, scripts, langues, packs et leurs droits) est repris du manifeste français.
title: La Kour — Fénoir (English)
description: Content for the original world « Fénoir » for the La Kour Survival system: surviving on Réunion Island at the start of an epidemic of the Pallid, in English. Sixteen regions of the island linked by their real roads and trails, some fifty shelter sites, thirty-odd installations (including a whole path to self-sufficiency), know-how, backgrounds, childhoods, traits, equipment, vehicles, recipes, diseases, factions, events, holidays, player and GM guides, the Book of the Island (the starting lore, readable by players), an opening scenario, a one-shot, a campaign in fronts, tables, the map of the island and maps of places. Original texts, for private use at the table. Tokens: icons from game-icons.net (CC BY 3.0), see CREDITS.md. — English edition of the French module lakour-fenoir: same documents, same identifiers, same registry keys; do not enable both at once. Any text not yet translated appears in French.
